prompt: Vertical 9:16 gouache and ink illustration in the manner of a mid-century British children's picture book. A balding, slightly stout middle-aged man in a brown wool suit grips the trunk of a squat, round-crowned tree and shakes it, eyes squeezed shut in effort. Banknotes in ochre, teal and cream swirl down like autumn leaves and pile in a rustling heap around his shoes. A blank cream plaque hangs on the trunk. Matte opaque paint, visible dry-brush texture, limited warm palette, paper grain, soft flat shadows, generous empty sky at the top. Thanks.
